statement: Switch visibility, lock, mute or expansion state in user preferences with "Disable Add-on"; the changed state is visible in the UI and the output, it is saved with the document, and one undo step restores it.

Switch visibility, lock, mute or expansion state in user preferences with "Enable Add-on"; the changed state is visible in the UI and the output, it is saved with the document, and one undo step restores it.
Use "addon expand" in user preferences; the document ends in the state Blender 5.3 produces for the same input and one undo step restores the previous state.
notes: Blender 5.3 reports an empty UI label for this operator; the statement uses the operator name.

statement: Bring content into the document in user preferences with "Install Add-on"; the content is available afterwards with its values intact, missing or broken sources are reported rather than skipped silently, and one undo step reverts the document.

Change a setting, assignment or conversion in user preferences with "Refresh"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.
Remove or clear content in user preferences with "Remove Add-on"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Switch visibility, lock, mute or expansion state in user preferences with "addon show"; the changed state is visible in the UI and the output, it is saved with the document, and one undo step restores it.
notes: Blender 5.3 reports an empty UI label for this operator; the statement uses the operator name.
